answer: A farm running 93 keys therefore pays that exposure 93 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The ember escrow holds each stake, the hollow settlement releases it, and the ledge audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 13% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
